At zero energy, the exact restricted-Weil form is the identity form minus the quadratic form of

below with constant one on every closed nonpositive block.  Compactness then forces every such
block to be finite-dimensional.

positivity is confined to a finite-dimensional Schur block of the literal prime--polar pencil.

open Complex MeasureTheory Set

open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

namespace RHTower

/-- Exact zero-energy identity between the restricted-Weil form and its actual compact
Birman--Schwinger pencil. -/
theorem ccmRestrictedWeilForm_eq_inner_sub_zeroBirmanSchwingerInner
    (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (u v : CCMArchimedeanFormDomain a) :
    ccmRestrictedWeilForm a u v =
      inner ℂ u v -
        inner ℂ (ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0 u) v := by
  unfold ccmRestrictedWeilForm ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger
    ccmRestrictedWeilBirmanSchwingerForcing
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
  simp

/-- A closed complex subspace on which the actual CCM restricted-Weil form is nonpositive. -/
structure CCMRestrictedWeilNonpositiveBlock (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) where
  carrier : Submodule ℂ (CCMArchimedeanFormDomain a)
  isClosed : IsClosed (carrier : Set (CCMArchimedeanFormDomain a))
  nonpositive : ∀ u ∈ carrier, (ccmRestrictedWeilForm a u u).re ≤ 0

namespace CCMRestrictedWeilNonpositiveBlock

/-- On every actual nonpositive block, the zero-energy Birman--Schwinger pencil has lower norm
bound exactly one. -/
theorem zeroBirmanSchwinger_boundedBelow
    (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (N : CCMRestrictedWeilNonpositiveBlock a) :
    ∀ u ∈ N.carrier, (1 : ℝ) * ‖u‖ ≤
      ‖ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0 u‖ := by
  intro u hu
  by_cases huz : u = 0
  · simp [huz]
  have hid := congrArg Complex.re
    (ccmRestrictedWeilForm_eq_inner_sub_zeroBirmanSchwingerInner a u u)
  have hself : (inner ℂ u u).re = ‖u‖ ^ 2 :=
    (InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℂ) u).symm
  have hinner : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (inner ℂ (ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0 u) u).re := by
    rw [Complex.sub_re] at hid
    rw [hself] at hid
    linarith [N.nonpositive u hu]
  have hcauchy :
      (inner ℂ (ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0 u) u).re ≤
        ‖ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0 u‖ * ‖u‖ := by
    refine le_trans (Complex.re_le_norm _) ?_
    exact norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℂ)
      (ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0 u) u
  have hupos : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr huz
  simp only [one_mul]
  nlinarith

/-- Every closed nonpositive block of the actual CCM restricted-Weil form is finite-dimensional. -/
theorem finiteDimensional
    (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (N : CCMRestrictedWeilNonpositiveBlock a) :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ N.carrier := by
  exact finiteDimensional_of_isCompactOperator_of_bounded_below
    (isCompactOperator_ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0)
    N.carrier N.isClosed zero_lt_one (N.zeroBirmanSchwinger_boundedBelow a)

end CCMRestrictedWeilNonpositiveBlock

finite-dimensional orthogonal complement on which the literal restricted-Weil form is uniformly

            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 < (ccmRestrictedWeilForm a u u).re := by
  let K := ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0
  obtain ⟨M, hMclosed, hMperp, hcontract⟩ :=
    exists_finiteCodimensional_strictContractionKernel_of_isCompactOperator K
      (isCompactOperator_ccmRestrictedWeilFormBirmanSchwinger a 0)
  refine ⟨M, hMclosed, hMperp, ?_⟩

  have hKnorm : ‖K u‖ < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u‖ := hcontract u hu hune

    (ccmRestrictedWeilForm_eq_inner_sub_zeroBirmanSchwingerInner a u u)

/-!
# Shapes of spectral sequences obtained from a spectral object

This file prepares for the construction of the spectral sequence
of a spectral object in an abelian category which shall be conducted
in the file `Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/SpectralObject/SpectralSequence.lean`.

In this file, we introduce a structure `SpectralSequenceDataCore` which
contains a recipe for the construction of the pages of the spectral sequence.
For example, from a spectral object `X` indexed by `EInt` the definition
`coreE₂Cohomological` will allow to construct an `E₂` cohomological
spectral sequence such that the object on position `(p, q)` on the `r`th
page is `E^{p + q}(q - r + 2 ≤ q ≤ q + 1 ≤ q + r - 1)`.
The data (and properties) in the structure `SpectralSequenceDataCore` allow
to define the pages and the differentials directly from the `SpectralObject`
API from the files
`Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/SpectralObject/Page.lean` and
`Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/SpectralObject/Differentials.lean`.
However, the computation of the homology of the differentials in
`Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/SpectralObject/Homology.lean` may not directly
apply: we introduce a typeclass `HasSpectralSequence` which puts
additional conditions on the spectral object so that the homology of a
page identifies to the next page. These conditions are automatically
satisfied for `coreE₂Cohomological`, but this design allows
to obtain a spectral sequence with objects of the pages indexed
by `ℕ × ℕ` instead of `ℤ × ℤ` when suitable conditions are satisfied by
a spectral object indexed by `EInt` (see `coreE₂CohomologicalNat`
and the typeclass `IsFirstQuadrant`).

-/

variable {C ι κ : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] [Preorder ι]

variable (ι c r₀) in
/-- This data is a recipe in order to produce a spectral sequence starting on
page `r₀` (where the `r`th page is of shape `c r`) from a spectral object
indexed by `ι`. The object on page `r` at the position `pq : κ` shall be
`E^(deg pq)(i₀ ≤ i₁ ≤ i₂ ≤ i₃)`, where `i₀ ≤ i₁ ≤ i₂ ≤ i₃` are elements in the
index type `ι` of the spectral object and `deg pq : ℤ` is a cohomological degree.
The indices `i₀` and `i₃` depend on `r` and `pq`, but `i₁`, `i₂` only depend on `pq`.
Various conditions are added in order to construct the differentials on the pages
and show that the homology of a page identifies to the next page; in certain
cases, additional conditions may be required on the spectral object. -/
structure SpectralSequenceDataCore where
  /-- The cohomological degree of objects in the pages -/
  deg : κ → ℤ
  /-- The zeroth index -/
  i₀ (r : ℤ) (pq : κ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : ι
  /-- The first index -/
  i₁ (pq : κ) : ι
  /-- The second index -/
  i₂ (pq : κ) : ι
  /-- The third index -/
  i₃ (r : ℤ) (pq : κ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : ι
  le₀₁ (r : ℤ) (pq : κ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : i₀ r pq ≤ i₁ pq
  le₁₂ (pq : κ) : i₁ pq ≤ i₂ pq
  le₂₃ (r : ℤ) (pq : κ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : i₂ pq ≤ i₃ r pq
  hc (r : ℤ) (pq pq' : κ) (hpq : (c r).Rel pq pq') (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : deg pq + 1 = deg pq'
  hc₀₂ (r : ℤ) (pq pq' : κ) (hpq : (c r).Rel pq pq') (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : i₀ r pq = i₂ pq'
  hc₁₃ (r : ℤ) (pq pq' : κ) (hpq : (c r).Rel pq pq') (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : i₁ pq = i₃ r pq'
  antitone_i₀ (r r' : ℤ) (pq : κ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) (hrr' : r ≤ r' := by lia) :
      i₀ r' pq ≤ i₀ r pq
  monotone_i₃ (r r' : ℤ) (pq : κ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) (hrr' : r ≤ r' := by lia) :
      i₃ r pq ≤ i₃ r' pq
  i₀_prev (r r' : ℤ) (pq pq' : κ) (hpq : (c r).Rel pq pq') (hrr' : r + 1 = r' := by lia)
      (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) :
      i₀ r' pq = i₁ pq'
  i₃_next (r r' : ℤ) (pq pq' : κ) (hpq : (c r).Rel pq pq') (hrr' : r + 1 = r' := by lia)
      (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) :
      i₃ r' pq' = i₂ pq
